frame_map: film frame f is scene frame 1 + 2 f at 24 scene frames per second

lens.note: r = theta / (fov / 2) of half the frame width; image circle touches all four edges

actors.description: Intruder: man in a dark shirt, waistcoat and trousers with a knit cap and a small backpack, carrying a hand torch
Lookout: man in a dark T-shirt, jeans and trainers

effects.detail: The intruder switches on a hand torch at the door. In these films the beam then fades, reaching dark at torch_off
Driveway and front floodlights and the portico pendant go to full
An upstairs room at the east end of the front lights up
The torch beam, fading since torch_on, reaches dark as the intruder runs
Both gate leaves start to swing shut

credits.author: Renderpeople
credits.changes: Shirt and tie recoloured through the supplied garment masks; whole colour map darkened by 20%; mesh subdivided once; cap, backpack and torch added; body driven by CMU motion capture; for the two infrared films the colour map is lifted (gamma 0.74) and the garment tints set to mid grey.
